name: United Airlines
fleetInfo: Starlink active on 300+ aircraft. 7M+ passengers connected, 129K+ Starlink flights flown. Free for MileagePlus members. Full fleet by end 2027.

name: American Airlines
fleetInfo: Free WiFi launched Jan 2026 via AT&T. Viasat/Intelsat on ~90% of fleet.

name: Delta Air Lines
fleetInfo: Free Viasat WiFi via Delta Sync on 1,000+ aircraft. Hughes on 717s and 400+ regional jets.

name: Southwest Airlines
fleetInfo: Free WiFi via Anuvu/Viasat since Oct 2025. Starlink deal signed Feb 2026 via T-Mobile partnership, first flights summer 2026, 300+ aircraft by end 2026. Free for Rapid Rewards members (free to join).

name: Alaska Airlines
fleetInfo: Starlink active on E175s since Dec 2025. Expanding to 737s/787s through 2026. Free for Atmos Rewards members via T-Mobile. Full fleet by 2027.

name: JetBlue Airways
fleetInfo: Free Fly-Fi powered by Viasat on all flights. Amazon Kuiper for future.

name: Air Canada
fleetInfo: Free WiFi via Bell on 88% fleet. Starlink on Q400s. Intelsat on E175s. Free for Aeroplan.

name: WestJet
fleetInfo: Starlink on 100+ of 147 737s via TELUS. World's largest Starlink 737 fleet. 787 Starlink by end 2026.

name: Hawaiian Airlines
fleetInfo: First US carrier with Starlink. Free on entire Airbus fleet.

name: Spirit Airlines
fleetInfo: Thales FlytLIVE on A320/A321 fleet. Paid from $5.99. Second Chapter 11 filing Aug 2025, fleet shrinking ~50%.

name: Frontier Airlines
fleetInfo: No WiFi currently. CEO confirmed WiFi coming, actively searching for vendor for 2026 launch.

name: British Airways
fleetInfo: Inmarsat/Panasonic on current fleet. IAG Starlink deal Nov 2025 covering 500+ IAG aircraft. Free Starlink rollout starting 2026.

name: Virgin Atlantic
fleetInfo: Viasat WiFi on current fleet (paid). First UK airline with Starlink from Q3 2026. Full fleet end 2027. Free for Flying Club.

name: Lufthansa
fleetInfo: Starlink for 850+ aircraft announced Jan 2026. Rollout H2 2026.

name: Air France
fleetInfo: Starlink active on ~80 aircraft (A220, E190, A350). ~30% fleet equipped. Free for Flying Blue. Full fleet end 2026.

name: KLM Royal Dutch Airlines
fleetInfo: Free Viasat WiFi on European flights from Jan 2026 for Flying Blue members. Panasonic on 787 long-haul.

name: Emirates
fleetInfo: Starlink active since Nov 2025. 232 aircraft fleet, ~14/month install rate. 150 equipped by end 2026, full fleet mid-2027. Free. A380 installations began Feb 2026 with 3-antenna setup for full coverage.

name: Qatar Airways
fleetInfo: ~120 widebody aircraft (A350, 777, 787) with Starlink. First 787 Dreamliner equipped Jan 2026. 11M+ passengers connected. Free. Full fleet by end 2026.

name: Singapore Airlines
fleetInfo: Starlink confirmed May 4, 2026. Progressive rollout from Q1 2027 across A350-900 long-haul/ULR + A380s, completion by end 2029. Up to 1 Gbps per antenna. Free for premium cabins and KrisFlyer/PPS members in PE/Y. Currently Panasonic Ku + Viasat Ka on 100% of fleet.

name: Qantas
fleetInfo: Free domestic WiFi via NBN. Viasat on international A330s from Mar 2025, 787s from 2026.

name: Etihad Airways
fleetInfo: Viasat Amara across majority of ~127 aircraft fleet. Free chat for members. A321LR, A350, 787 factory-installed.

name: Turkish Airlines
fleetInfo: Turk Telekom WiFi Fly on 777, 787, 737 MAX, A330, A350, A321neo. Free for Business and Miles&Smiles members. Active tender for Starlink/Inmarsat.

name: Cathay Pacific
fleetInfo: WiFi 100% fleet. Panasonic on A350s, Intelsat 2Ku (formerly Gogo) on 777s/A330s.

name: Japan Airlines
fleetInfo: Panasonic and Intelsat. Free unlimited for First/Business intl since Oct 2024. Economy gets 1hr free intl. Free domestic with streaming.

name: All Nippon Airways
fleetInfo: Free WiFi international via Viasat Amara (Aug 2025).

name: Air India
fleetInfo: WiFi on A350, 787-9, A321neo since Jan 2025. Free for introductory period (may become paid). First Indian airline with domestic WiFi.
